name: OpenAI whisper-1 shuts down on 26 Feb 2027; move to gpt-transcribe
gain: After 26 Feb 2027 audio sent to these models fails. OpenAI lists gpt-transcribe at $0.0045 a minute and gpt-live-transcribe at $0.017 a minute.
how: For recorded audio, change whisper-1 to gpt-transcribe on /v1/audio/transcriptions. For live audio, use gpt-live-transcribe. Test with audio like yours: accents, noise, names and numbers.
trade_offs: The new models take a languages list instead of the singular language field.
Transcripts will differ, so anything that compares text exactly can break.
An OpenAI-compatible server that only offers whisper-1 is not affected, so check who the code calls.
needs: Nothing new; the same OpenAI key.
price: gpt-transcribe $0.0045 a minute; gpt-live-transcribe $0.017 a minute.
